title: James B. Coker
clean_html:
James B. Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-j3.htm

He married Cleo Durham, the daughter of W. Thomas Durham and Mamie Beckett. Cleo was born in Kent Co., DE on October 01, 1920 and died August 12, 1994. They had the following children: Karen Coker (1952- ) Sherry Coker (1962- ) Beth Coker (1965- )
